svg.title: SyncTube architecture
svg.desc: Each party member's browser runs the SynctubePlayer component, which drives a YouTube IFrame player and a socket.io-client connection. server.js is one Node HTTP server on port 9002 that serves the Next.js 15 app and hosts a Socket.IO server; party state lives in an in-memory rooms Map that is deleted when a room empties. Clients emit join-party, change-video, sync-play, pause, seek and sync-to-time; the server broadcasts room-state, video-changed, play-synced, paused, seeked, synced-to-time, user-joined and user-left. A Genkit scaffold in src/ai defines no flows.
